title: License Manifest
description: License manifest for a dataset or source registered in the Source Registry (data/registry/sources.yaml). Every dataset must have a manifest before it can be used. A dataset without a manifest, or with UNVERIFIED license, is excluded by the data gate. Spec: Part 3 §3.12, P02-T03.

source_id.description: Identifier matching a source_id in data/registry/sources.yaml.

terms.description: Human-readable summary of the license terms. Use 'not read; UNVERIFIED' until the V-item is closed by the owner.

attribution_text.description: Required attribution text as specified by the license, or 'none required' or 'not read; UNVERIFIED'.

permitted_uses.description: Description of permitted uses, or 'not verified'.

redistribution_permission.description: Whether redistribution is permitted and under what conditions. Must be one of: yes, no, unknown, not-applicable.

notes.description: Optional notes or caveats about the license or its interpretation.
